urlText: Sydney Domestic Airport Station Lift between the pedestrian tunnel and the concourse is not available
content:
At Sydney Domestic Airport Station Lift between the pedestrian tunnel and the concourse is temporarily out of service.
Lift access at Domestic Airport station is not available until 20 February 2025 due to a lift upgrade. Baggage handlers are on site to assist. If you require mobility assistance you will need to go to International Terminal station. T-Bus services are available between International Airport near the Taxi Rank at arrivals and Domestic Airport outside arrivals at both T2/T3 terminals.
If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 8337 8450.

content:

From Monday 16 December to Monday 6 January, the lift will be closed for maintenance. 
Direct lift access is still available from Harvey Road to the concourse. 
From Railway Road, follow the signs to the underpass, to access the lift on Harvey Road
